text:
Nora Li: dropping a concise handoff + surge mitigation checklist for accounts heading into promotions or campaigns. copyable to customers.
Samir Desai: nice — can we include one tiny prefill example and a 2-question pulse? makes it easy for SAs.
Nora Li: yup. first pass below.
Nora Li: ```Customer-facing 5-step surge handoff (for promo/campaign bursts)
1) Snapshot: share last 7d p95 latency, 24h token change %, and error rate. flag if p95 > 800ms or errors > 0.8%.
2) Preheat (customer action): run top-3 prompts with prefill_tokens=800-1200, interval 10s, 3 repeats each to hydrate KV.
3) Server-side suggestions: batch_window=30-70ms, max_concurrency_per_user=2, timeout=6s. recommend keeping quantization off during initial 48h.
4) Streaming fallback: if stream_gap_ms p90 > 180ms, switch to single-response mode for that route.
5) Feedback capture: quick 2-question pulse after 24h: (1) How useful was the assistant? 0-10; (2) Any accuracy regressions? yes/no + comment.```
Helen Ortiz: small edit: change p95 threshold to 700ms for high-interactivity customers and call out a 48h warm-pool window after any large prefill.
Ravi Menon: adding a tiny prefill curl for eng teams:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"account_id":"acct_ABC","model":"reply-pro","samples":[{"prompt":"<promptA>","tokens":1000},{"prompt":"<promptB>","tokens":1000}],"spacing_seconds":10}'
```Note: run with max 2 concurrent clients.
Samir Desai: please include the telemetry keys we expect so SAs can ask customers to share them.
Nora Li: telemetry keys: "cs.request_id", "redwood.latency_p95", "redwood.errors_rate", "redwood.cache.hit_ratio", "redwood.stream_gap_p90", "cs.tokens_out".
Helen Ortiz: offer a short customer note template we can paste into email.
Nora Li:```Hi <Name>,
We ran a warmup for your assistant ahead of the campaign. Two quick asks: 1) Could you reply with overall helpfulness (0-10)? 2) Did you notice any drops in relevance/accuracy? (yes/no + short note)
If you want, we can run another targeted prefill for your top 5 prompts this week.
Thanks,
<SA name>
```
Ravi Menon: tiny observability assertion to verify cache warming (python):```python
# run after prefill finishes
def cache_warm(client):
    m = client.query_metrics("redwood.cache.hit_ratio", window="1h")
    return getattr(m, 'p90', 0) >= 0.55
```
Samir Desai: add a simple renewal triage heuristic so CSMs know when to escalate.
Helen Ortiz: quick heuristic: High risk = usage drop >35% in 14d OR satisfaction <5 OR unresolved quality regression in last 7d -> escalate to eng + CS within 48-72h. Medium = 15-35% drop or p95 600-800ms -> follow up with targeted prefill and 7-day monitor. Low = stable usage + sat >=7 -> standard cadence.
Nora Li: perfect. I'll publish this as a one-pager in the CS runbook and add a TL;DR for #account-health. tagging @Samir for final wording and @Ravi for the prefill snippet.
CS Bot: reminder — add runbook file /repos/cs/runbooks/surge-handoff-playbook.md; label: "surge-handoff".
Nora Li: thanks team, will follow up after posting. :rocket:
